name: blueprint/cli-ops
description: Any CLI operated safely: mutating subcommands behind guard ask, one receipt per invocation, verification with the same command
recipe: identify the subcommand and its effect -> gate mutating subcommands behind ask -> run and receipt (exit + tail) -> verify with the same command
pitfalls: argv arrays only - no shell operators
mutating subcommands carry ask, reads do not
the receipt tail is the evidence, keep it short but real
